analysis: Both sides picked up real injury news overnight. New Orleans now has both starting off-ball linebackers -- Kaden Elliss and Anfernee Jennings -- confirmed out (neither practiced all week), which the model treats as a depth-exhaustion stack on top of each player individually. New York adds Andrew Thomas (groin, questionable) and Jermaine Eluemunor (calf, questionable) along the line, plus Tyler Nubin, Theo Johnson and Colton Hood all out. Both offenses and defenses are thinner than a day ago, and the model has shifted the projected total down to 40.5 against a 46.5 DraftKings number -- a 6-point gap.

The spread read is unchanged: Giants cover the home number in 69.3% of sims even with Kamara and Carter still question marks on both sides, so New Orleans being a slight favorite on the scoreboard does not carry through to the point spread. The total is now the more interesting number given how many bodies are out on both sides of the ball.
